prompt: The attached image is a 300x300 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<style>html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#c4e3f0}canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:300px;height:300px}</style>
</head><body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);renderer.setSize(300,300);document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();
// background
const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=64;cv.height=64;const cx=cv.getContext('2d');
const lg=cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,64);lg.addColorStop(0,'#cfe9f4');lg.addColorStop(1,'#b8dcee');cx.fillStyle=lg;cx.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
function blob(x,y,r,a){const g=cx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,'+a+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');cx.fillStyle=g;cx.fillRect(0,0,64,64);}
blob(8,6,24,0.8);blob(4,60,20,0.85);blob(34,2,16,0.5);blob(62,44,10,0.4);
const bg=new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);bg.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;scene.background=bg;
// lights
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,1.3));
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff,0xe0b070,1.0));
const d1=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,2.2);d1.position.set(-2,5,7);scene.add(d1);
const d2=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1.2);d2.position.set(3,2,-6);scene.add(d2);
// materials
const yellow=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xf4b02c,roughness:0.65});
const cream=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xcfc4ab,roughness:0.8});
const gray=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x5e5e5c,roughness:0.8});
const dark=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x1a0e0b,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const teethM=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xefeae0,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const lowM=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xb5aaa5,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const browM=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x2a1608});
const sg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,32);
function sph(p,mat,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,name){const m=new THREE.Mesh(sg,mat);m.position.set(x,y,z);m.scale.set(sx,sy===undefined?sx:sy,sz===undefined?sx:sz);if(name)m.name=name;p.add(m);return m;}
const UP=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
function seg(p,a,b,ra,rb,mat){const d=b.clone().sub(a);const len=d.length();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rb,ra,len,24,1,true),mat);
  m.position.copy(a).addScaledVector(d,0.5);m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP,d.normalize());p.add(m);
  sph(p,mat,a.x,a.y,a.z,ra);sph(p,mat,b.x,b.y,b.z,rb);}
const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
// character
const ch=new THREE.Group();ch.name='character-yellow';scene.add(ch);
const body=new THREE.Group();body.name='body';ch.add(body);
sph(body,yellow,0.05,-0.55,0,1.6,1.75,1.35,'torso');
sph(body,yellow,0.1,0.35,0,1.3,1.05,1.1,'chest');
const belly=new THREE.Group();belly.name='belly';ch.add(belly);
sph(belly,cream,0.17,-0.6,0.42,1.15,1.1,1.05,'belly-patch');
const legs=new THREE.Group();legs.name='legs';ch.add(legs);
sph(legs,yellow,-0.75,-2.2,0.35,0.5,0.3,0.7,'foot-right');
sph(legs,yellow,0.85,-2.2,0.35,0.5,0.3,0.7,'foot-left');
// head
const R=0.72;
const head=new THREE.Group();head.name='head';head.position.set(0.91,0.99,0.4);head.rotation.z=-0.2;ch.add(head);
sph(head,yellow,0,0,0,R,R,R,'skull');
function decal(fn,cx0,cy0,Rr,mat,name){const N=6,M=40,pos=[],idx=[];
  const zf=(x,y)=>Math.sqrt(Math.max(Rr*Rr-x*x-y*y,1e-4));
  pos.push(cx0,cy0,zf(cx0,cy0));
  for(let i=1;i<=N;i++)for(let j=0;j<M;j++){const t=j/M*Math.PI*2,b=fn(t),f=i/N;const x=cx0+b[0]*f,y=cy0+b[1]*f;pos.push(x,y,zf(x,y));}
  for(let j=0;j<M;j++)idx.push(0,1+j,1+(j+1)%M);
  for(let i=1;i<N;i++)for(let j=0;j<M;j++){const a=1+(i-1)*M+j,b=1+(i-1)*M+(j+1)%M,c=1+i*M+j,d=1+i*M+(j+1)%M;idx.push(a,c,d,a,d,b);}
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));g.setIndex(idx);g.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(g,mat);m.name=name;return m;}
const mouth=new THREE.Group();mouth.name='mouth';head.add(mouth);
const ox=-0.08,oy=-0.12,ma=0.36;
mouth.add(decal(t=>{const s=Math.sin(t);return[ma*Math.cos(t),(s>=0?0.03*s:0.45*s)+0.2];},ox,oy-0.2,R+0.006,dark,'mouth-inside'));
mouth.add(decal(t=>{const s=Math.sin(t);return[0.92*ma*Math.cos(t),(s>=0?0.02*s:0.085*s)+0.02];},ox,oy-0.02,R+0.013,teethM,'teeth-upper'));
mouth.add(decal(t=>{const s=Math.sin(t);return[0.18*Math.cos(t),(s>=0?0.05:0.07)*s];},ox,oy-0.33,R+0.013,lowM,'teeth-lower'));
// eyes (closed happy arcs)
const eyes=new THREE.Group();eyes.name='eyes';head.add(eyes);
function eye(x,y,tilt,name){const arc=Math.PI*0.75;const g=new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.1,0.02,8,20,arc);g.rotateZ((Math.PI-arc)/2+tilt);
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(g,browM);const z=Math.sqrt(R*R-x*x-y*y);const n=V(x,y,z).normalize();
  m.position.copy(n).multiplyScalar(R+0.005);m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,0,1),n);
  const grp=new THREE.Group();grp.name=name;grp.add(m);eyes.add(grp);}
eye(-0.29,0.19,-0.25,'eye-right');eye(0.27,0.19,0.25,'eye-left');
// arms
function hand(name,mirror){const h=new THREE.Group();h.name=name;
  sph(h,gray,0,0,0,0.17,0.15,0.1);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=V(0.1,0.09-0.06*i,0.02);const d=V(1,-0.35-0.15*i,-0.25).normalize();seg(h,a,a.clone().addScaledVector(d,0.17),0.05,0.045,gray);}
  const ta=V(0,0.1,0.03);seg(h,ta,ta.clone().addScaledVector(V(0.4,1,-0.1).normalize(),0.09),0.05,0.045,gray);
  if(mirror){h.scale.x=-1;h.rotation.z=0.3;}else h.rotation.z=-0.3;return h;}
function arm(name,S,E,W,H,r0,r1,r2,handName,mirror){const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;g.position.copy(S);
  const e=E.clone().sub(S),w=W.clone().sub(S),hp=H.clone().sub(S);
  seg(g,V(0,0,0),e,r0,r1,yellow);seg(g,e,w,r1,r2,yellow);
  const h=hand(handName,mirror);h.position.copy(hp);g.add(h);ch.add(g);return g;}
arm('arm-right',V(-1.0,0.2,0.55),V(-1.15,-0.8,0.95),V(-0.38,-1.0,1.38),V(0.0,-0.97,1.52),0.5,0.42,0.27,'hand-right',false);
arm('arm-left',V(1.35,0.1,0.45),V(1.5,-0.8,0.9),V(0.98,-1.02,1.35),V(0.63,-0.97,1.5),0.45,0.38,0.25,'hand-left',true);
// camera
const ref=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(18,1,2,60);ref.position.set(0,0,9.5);ref.lookAt(0,0,0);
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[ch],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body></html>
